_purpose: Identity manifest for the four real documents used to validate layout-aware extraction. The PDFs themselves are NOT committed: they are third-party documents and only their identity and provenance belong in this repository.
_status: All four documents PRESENT and verified on 2026-10-13. CHP_AURAL_BREVITY and IN_ISP_COMMUNICATIONS were downloaded inside the build environment by scripts/fetch_layout_validation.py on 2026-10-12 (UTC) and matched expected_sha256 and expected_byte_length exactly. PHL_PPD_DIRECTIVE_7_1: CONNECT to www.phillypolice.com succeeded, but its origin (Cloudflare) answered the script with HTTP 403 twice, so the file was downloaded by hand in a browser from its canonical_url and placed here; it matches expected_sha256 and expected_byte_length exactly. FL_FHP_POLICY_14_01 was fetched once from its canonical_url with no redirect and content-type application/pdf; its expected_sha256 is the hash of those bytes (see hash_provenance on that entry). Nothing was substituted for any document.
_directory: data/raw/layout-validation/ (git-ignored except this manifest and README)
_identity_rule: Before a document is used, its SHA-256 must equal expected_sha256 below. A file that does not match is a different document and must not be used, however similar its name.
_hash_provenance: For CHP_AURAL_BREVITY, IN_ISP_COMMUNICATIONS and PHL_PPD_DIRECTIVE_7_1, expected_sha256 is the document hash recorded by the previous sprint in data/audit/real_documents.jsonl and data/audit/real_sources.jsonl at acquisition time (2026-09-20T07:02Z), reproduced byte-for-byte on 2026-09-22 by a copy placed by hand. For FL_FHP_POLICY_14_01 there was no prior audit: expected_sha256 is the hash of the bytes received on first acquisition (2026-10-12) and has not been independently audited. These two kinds of hash are not equally attested.
_excluded_documents_note: excluded_documents lists a document that was in this set and no longer is. It is kept rather than deleted so the set cannot be silently restored to four without reading why it became three. Nothing reads it: the scripts iterate documents only. Removal from this set is scoped to layout validation and changes no historical measurement — CHI_CPD_DIRECTIVE remains in DOCUMENT_KEYS and in the audit, replay, coverage and adjudication artifacts, which record what a previous sprint measured when the document was retrievable.

excluded_documents.excluded_because: The source cannot supply a document matching expected_sha256, and no substitute may be used in its place. https://directives.chicagopolice.org/api/publicDirective/6607 builds the PDF per request instead of serving a stored file: the footer of all eleven pages carries the download time to the minute, and the trailer /ID and CreationDate are fresh each time, so four downloads on 2026-09-22 produced four different whole-file hashes (30638b53..., 7aa0f6e5..., 30638b53..., 08263c40...) at 104500 and 104508 bytes. The audited copy from 2026-09-20T06:59:36Z carried that minute's stamp; data/raw/documents/4e7ce304....pdf is absent from the working tree, from every branch and from this machine, so expected_sha256 can never be reproduced by anyone.

identity_evidence_not_acted_on._note: Recorded because it is what a future decision would rest on, not because it was accepted. The document that arrives is almost certainly the right one; a whole-file hash is simply the wrong identity test for a per-request-generated source. Re-admitting this document requires deciding on an identity rule for such sources, not editing expected_sha256 to match whatever arrived.
